items.title: 1 Stage-1 unlock: rear dome with two thigh lobes
items.evidence: 5_reference row 3 model az180 and 1_beauty back34 still show square haunches with vertical outer walls, flat back wall and a flat-faced thigh block as tall as the belly; no light gap between belly and thigh. Tri count is 2994 in techqa (check asked 900-1400).

items.title: 2 Spots as round discs
items.evidence: 1_beauty az090 and 5_reference top now show hexagonal disc spots (clear gain, 3_tech/techqa piece_spots float 0 zfight 0), but sizes vary and back34/az180 still show small dark flake-like slivers along the spine that read as debris, not dots.

items.title: 3 Bigger bulging eyes
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000 and az090: gold balls are large, stand proud above the turret and break the skull silhouette at top and side; 3_tech eyes grey, no float.

items.title: 4 Mouth to under eye, no pink at rest
items.evidence: 1_beauty az090: black mouth line runs back to under the eye; az000 and 2_closeups head colour show no pink; 4_posed attack_f012 still shows the lash. Minor: a tiny pink dot is faintly visible in the 2_closeups toes-panel thumbnail.

items.title: 5 Ragged cream flank border
items.evidence: 1_beauty az090: cream flank is now a mostly clean vertical strip behind the foreleg, but its lower end is still jagged with a notch and a few stray cream facets near the thigh; not one convex edge to the floor.
